answer: One defence is a bonded pulse check: each identity locks a refundable stake and must answer unpredictable, short-window liveness pulses signed with its own key, like a juniper hedge that only lets through what it has already vetted. A newcomer cannot forge standing by copying another agent's answers, because each pulse is unique to its key and expires in seconds. Running many fake identities means funding a stake and staying online for every one of them around the clock, so the operator's cost grows with each Sybil while a single honest agent pays only once.
